about: A web app where amateur radio operators log the contacts they make and sync them with services like LoTW.

prs.title: Valid LoTW certificates are no longer rejected
prs.broken: Uploading a valid LoTW certificate could fail with "Generic error" because of a leftover error from an earlier request.
prs.changed: Old errors are cleared before the certificate is read, so only real problems count.
prs.matters: Operators can upload their certificate and sync their log without a confusing failure.

prs.title: First QSO is kept when the API gets a WSJT-X log
prs.broken: When ADIF sent to the API ended its header in lowercase, as WSJT-X writes it, the first contact was silently dropped.
prs.changed: The header end is now found in any letter case.
prs.matters: Logs pushed from WSJT-X and JTDX import every contact.
